_doc: The Specialization roster (Fable, 2026-11-10; docs/SPECS.md). Rulings 2, 10, 29, 30, 35: Path at 3, Spec at 10, spec skills replace Path skills, 3 trees of 8-10 nodes each, rolled out in waves (wave 1 = one pure spec per Path + Paladin + Spellblade). FIELDS: paths (1 = pure, 2 = hybrid: pick it from either), resource (the PRIMARY resource its costs are written in) + altResource (the other Path's; hybrid actives carry `altCost` in it), armour/weapons/offhand ADDED to the Path's proficiency at 10 (content.js writes them to items.proficiency[spec]; every Fighter-reachable spec gets plate, the Paladin mail+plate, the Spellblade leather), starter (granted at rank 1 at the spec pick; wave 1 only until a wave's trees exist), tvClass (the Thousandvale class it carries over), wave (1-5), trees (3 ids - the tree field of its skills). 31 specs = Thousandvale's 32 minus the Tactician (owner: turn-based orders do not fit) and with the Star Blade FOLDED INTO the Spellblade (same fantasy - a sword with a spell on it, a star shield, tethers, a comet rush - so the owner's named hybrid carries a Thousandvale class instead of being a 33rd). RENAMED (other games' class names, a Path name clash, or a monster-role clash): Warrior -> Vanguard, Fighter -> Weaponmaster, Demon Hunter -> Reckoner, Shaman -> Spirit Speaker (the bestiary's shaman ROLE keeps the word), Witch Hunter -> Hexbreaker, Dragon Knight -> Wyrmblood, Shadow Dancer -> Shade Dancer, Mage -> Frostbinder, Rogue -> Assassin, Priest -> Dusk Priest. KEPT as generic words: Paladin, Knight, Ranger, Cleric, Bard, Monk, Druid, Necromancer, Warlock, Sorcerer, Enchanter, Oracle, Tinker, Scavenger, Swashbuckler, Pyromancer, Stormcaller, Starcaller, Chronomancer, Runesmith. HYBRIDS (7): Paladin F/H, Spellblade F/M, Druid H/M, Bard H/R, Monk F/R, Hexbreaker R/H, Spirit Speaker H/M. Waves 2-5 list fantasy + tree names only; their trees land with their milestone (M22/24/26/28).

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.blurb: The front of the line. Stronger the more of them there are: spins, shoves and a stamp that splits the ground.
vanguard.fantasy: Thousandvale's Warrior. You walk into the middle of the pack on purpose. Crowd Swing and Iron Gyre are the filler, Hold the Line makes them all look at you, and Groundbreaker is a stunning line through everything in front of you. Plate at ten.

trees.name: Thick of It
trees.blurb: Crowd damage: swings, spins and a two-handed bleed, ending in Avalanche.

trees.name: Iron Will
trees.blurb: The tank: an area taunt, armour, wards for you and the party, ending in Bastion.

trees.name: Breaking Line
trees.blurb: One target and control: shoves, armour cracks, a chase, a finishing blow, the Groundbreaker line, and Doubled Grasp (a two-handed weapon in each hand).

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.blurb: A bow, a hound and a bag of snares. Name the quarry, hold them with nets, shoot from the perch the archers wanted.
ranger.fantasy: Thousandvale's Ranger with its hound made real: a strong pet that bites what bites you, a Quarry mark the whole party kills through, and the bow kit (Broadhead, Full Draw, Piercing Shot, Arrow Storm). Snarework is the control tree: roots, caltrops, nets, a pinning interrupt.

trees.name: Far Shot
trees.blurb: The bow: Broadhead filler, Full Draw, a piercing line, a fan, and Arrow Storm.

trees.name: The Hunt
trees.blurb: The hound (two kinds), the Quarry mark, the killing shot, and three wolves at twenty.

trees.name: Snarework
trees.blurb: Snares, caltrops, nets, a leap back and a pinning interrupt, ending in Killing Ground.

pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
pyromancer.blurb: Everything burns. Kindle a target, scorch it hotter, set the whole pack off at once; a little fire follows you and throws itself at what you fight.
pyromancer.fantasy: Thousandvale's Pyromancer. Burns are the whole kit: Kindle and Scorch stack them, Flashover and Immolate cash them in; Burning Line, Fallstone and Firestorm are the ground fire; the Familiar is a pet that is also your fire. Cloth, so Cinder Stride and Ash Cloud are how you stay alive.

trees.name: Kindling
trees.blurb: Bolts and the burn: Kindle, Scorch, Flashover, Immolate.

trees.name: Wildfire
trees.blurb: Lines, falling rock, firestorms and choking ash, ending in Conflagration.

trees.name: The Familiar
trees.blurb: A fire that follows you (two kinds), the skin that does not burn, a snuffing interrupt, and Pyre Heart.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.blurb: Heals that spill over into wards, a circle of safe ground, the fallen raised, and a lance of sunlight that pays for all of it.
cleric.fantasy: Thousandvale's Cleric. Brightmend heals and leaves the overflow as a ward; Sanctuary and Circle of Light keep four people up; Raise the Fallen is the revive; Falling Light is the smite that also heals, so a Cleric alone clears a zone.

trees.name: Overflow
trees.blurb: One friend, kept standing: Brightmend, Guardian Light, wards, a cleansing word, Absolution.

trees.name: Sanctuary
trees.blurb: Ground and the whole party: Sanctuary, Circle of Light, the revive, a hymn, Daybreak.

trees.name: Falling Light
trees.blurb: The light that bites: Sunlance, Falling Light, Censure, Judgement, Noonfire, Light Unbearable.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.blurb: Every swing heals someone. A ward for the party sworn on your own life, a leap to the friend in trouble, and the fallen lifted back up.
paladin.fantasy: Thousandvale's Paladin, reachable from Fighter OR Healer. Sanctified Blade heals everyone near you as it cuts; Mercy's Touch is an instant heal because you are in melee; Daybreak Descent jumps you onto a friend and takes what is on them; Bulwark is a full tank line. From Fighter it runs on temper (hits feed it); from Healer on mana (the same skills, priced in mana).

trees.name: Holy Blade
trees.blurb: Melee that heals: Sanctified Blade, Hammer of Light, Radiant Sweep, Daybreak Strike.

trees.name: Oath of Mercy
trees.blurb: The friend in trouble: an instant heal, a party ward, the leap, a cleanse, Oathbound Rise.

trees.name: Bulwark
trees.blurb: The wall with a prayer behind it: area taunt, blessed ground, armour, a taunting interrupt, Unyielding Oath.

spellblade.name: Spellblade
spellblade.blurb: A sword with a storm along the edge. Cut, shield, drag them in on threads of light, pin them, and arrive like a comet.
spellblade.fantasy: Thousandvale's Star Blade in a Spellblade's skin, reachable from Fighter OR Mage. Starcut is steel plus storm (armour or resist, whichever is weaker); Star Aegis is a ward that flashes outward; Star Tether drags an archer off its perch; Binding Stars pins a pack; Comet Rush and Heaven's Edge are the ways in and through. From Fighter on temper, from Mage on mana.

trees.name: Edgework
trees.blurb: The blade carries the spell: Starcut, Bright Arc, Riven Star, Collapsing Star.

trees.name: Starward
trees.blurb: The star shield, the tether, the hold, a silencing interrupt, Star Bastion.

trees.name: Comet
trees.blurb: Be somewhere else, hitting something: Comet Rush, Thrown Star, Flicker Cut, Comet Fall, Heaven's Edge.

knight.name: Knight
knight.blurb: Takes the blows meant for others. A sworn guard on one friend, a challenge to the pack, a raised wall, a banner that keeps everyone standing.
knight.fantasy: Thousandvale's Knight: the purest tank. Sworn Guard links you to a friend so their damage comes to you; Challenge and Rim Strike are taunts; Rampart is a wall; Unbroken Banner a party ward.

trees.name: Sworn Guard
trees.blurb: Linked protection: take a friend's hits, wards, intercepts.

trees.name: Challenge
trees.blurb: Taunts, shield blows, a rim strike that stuns, the interrupt.

trees.name: Banner
trees.blurb: Party-wide standing: armour, heals landing harder, Unbroken Banner.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.blurb: Set it up, then cash in. Poisons and bleeds first, a stun, a mark that pays twice, a cut from behind that ends it.
assassin.fantasy: Thousandvale's Rogue. Gutting Strike and the back-cut, poison darts, a Grave Mark that makes the target pay twice, Slip Away leaving a decoy, Knife Storm for the pack.

trees.name: Venoms
trees.blurb: Poisons and bleeds that stack and spread.

trees.name: The Set-up
trees.blurb: Marks, stuns and the cash-in from behind.

trees.name: Slip Away
trees.blurb: Decoys, escapes, the hush and the knife storm.

frostbinder.name: Frostbinder
frostbinder.blurb: Frost then shatter. Shards and blizzards slow and bite, a rime spear breaks what they left, and nothing in the pack moves at full speed.
frostbinder.fantasy: Thousandvale's Mage (frost artillery). Frost Shard, Rime Burst, Whiteout; the shatter (Rime Spear, Stillfrost) that does more to the slowed; Spellrush for three free fast casts.

trees.name: Rime
trees.blurb: Shards, bursts and the shatter.

trees.name: Whiteout
trees.blurb: Blizzards, walls of ice, ground that holds.

trees.name: Stillness
trees.blurb: Spellrush, wards of ice, the freeze, the escape.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.blurb: Shocked targets take more from everything. Bolts that fork between enemies, orbs that circle you, a step of lightning out of trouble.
stormcaller.fantasy: Thousandvale's Stormcaller. Forked Bolt jumps the pack, Thunder Ring, Storm Beam, Storm Orbs as a standing aura, Bolt Step as the dash, Eye of the Tempest as the long storm.

trees.name: Forked
trees.blurb: Bolts that chain, shock marks, the beam.

trees.name: Thunder
trees.blurb: Rings, orbs and the tempest.

trees.name: Bolt Step
trees.blurb: Mobility, wards of wind, the stunning strike.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.blurb: Sees it coming. Wards everyone against the next big hit, marks where the blast will fall, and takes a friend's wound as its own.
oracle.fantasy: Thousandvale's Oracle: the ward healer. Foresight shields the party before the hit, Kind Omen heals and wards one, Thread of Fate takes damage for a friend, Prophecy marks the blast.

trees.name: Foresight
trees.blurb: Wards before the hit, on one and on all.

trees.name: Omens
trees.blurb: Heals that arrive early, cleansing, the revive.

trees.name: Prophecy
trees.blurb: Bolts of fate, marks, a slow on what is coming.

swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler
swashbuckler.blurb: Flair rewards variety. A leap, a mocking parry, a matador's turn, and one grand sweep that spends the show.
swashbuckler.fantasy: Thousandvale's Swashbuckler. Flourish, Daring Leap, Mocking Parry (a taunt with a riposte), Pinning Thrust, Matador's Turn, Grandeur. The engine addition it wants is a Flair counter that rewards not repeating a skill.

trees.name: Flourish
trees.blurb: The thrusts and the sweep.

trees.name: Panache
trees.blurb: Leaps, parries, the turn, the escape.

trees.name: Grandeur
trees.blurb: Variety pays: the finisher and what feeds it.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.blurb: Every kill is a body to use. Raise thralls, burn the rest in a pyre, drain life back, and march the buried out.
necromancer.fantasy: Thousandvale's Necromancer: the summoner. Raise Thrall (minions to the cap), Corpse Pyre, Marrow Lance, Grave Draught, Unquiet Return (a grave-touched revive), March of the Buried. The engine addition it wants is a corpse count from recent kills.

trees.name: Thralls
trees.blurb: Raise, command and strengthen the dead.

trees.name: Marrow
trees.blurb: Bone lances, drains and curses.

trees.name: The Pyre
trees.blurb: Burn the bodies, the grave-touched revive, the march.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.blurb: Health as fuel, curses that spread. A bound fiend fights for you, a rift drags the pack together and copies every curse onto it.
warlock.fantasy: Thousandvale's Warlock: curses (dots) that spread, a Soul Pact that makes them tick faster, a bound imp pet, Void Rift as the pull. The engine additions it wants are a health cost and dot copying.

trees.name: Gnawing Dark
trees.blurb: Curses, drains and their spread.

trees.name: The Fiend
trees.blurb: The bound pet and what it does for you.

trees.name: The Rift
trees.blurb: Pulls, gates, and the health-fuelled burst.

druid.name: Druid
druid.blurb: Change shape and every skill changes with you: a thorned bear-thing, a fast wolf, a spore-lobbing healer.
druid.fantasy: Thousandvale's Druid, from Healer OR Mage (both run on mana, so no altCost). Three shapes as stances, Thornlash, Greensap, Green Return as the revive. The engine addition it wants is a stance that swaps the action bar.

trees.name: Briarback
trees.blurb: The thorned tank shape.

trees.name: Fenrunner
trees.blurb: The fast wolf shape.

trees.name: Sporecap
trees.blurb: The healing shape: spores, greensap, the bloom revive.

weaponmaster.name: Weaponmaster
weaponmaster.blurb: An open stance and a closed one, and a riposte for whatever comes next. Lunge and flurry change with your stance.
weaponmaster.fantasy: Thousandvale's Fighter (the stance duelist), renamed because Fighter is a Path here. Open stance (faster, harder) and Closed (heavier armour) as stances; Riposte and Sweeping Guard answer the next blow.

trees.name: Open Stance
trees.blurb: Speed and precision.

trees.name: Closed Stance
trees.blurb: Guard, ripostes, the counter.

trees.name: Mastery
trees.blurb: Lunges, flurries, the stance-changing capstone.

reckoner.name: Reckoner
reckoner.blurb: Every hit you take is a debt. Brand them, hook them in, tumble clear, set the hound on them, and settle it all in one shot.
reckoner.fantasy: Thousandvale's Demon Hunter, renamed. Brand Bolt, Chain Hook (a pull), Tumbling Shot, Unleash the Hound (a pet), Settle the Grudge (a shot that spends what you took), Night Hunt. Wants a grudge counter from hits taken.

trees.name: The Brand
trees.blurb: Marks and bolts.

trees.name: The Hook
trees.blurb: Pulls, tumbles and the hound.

trees.name: The Reckoning
trees.blurb: The debt and the settling of it.

dusk_priest.name: Dusk Priest
dusk_priest.blurb: Heals by striking. Every shadow lance mends the most hurt friend, a vigil saves everyone from one killing blow, and the fallen rise mid-fight.
dusk_priest.fantasy: Thousandvale's Priest (light and shadow), renamed. Shadow Lance and Twinlight heal the most hurt ally as they hit, Vigil (a pre-paid save), Mark the Killer, Second Dawn (a combat revive).

trees.name: Twinlight
trees.blurb: Shadow that heals as it hits.

trees.name: Vigil
trees.blurb: Pre-paid saves, wards, the mid-fight revive.

trees.name: Dawn
trees.blurb: Prayers, circles, the mark.

bard.name: Bard
bard.blurb: One song at a time: valour speeds your friends, ruin curses your enemies, mending heals everyone near you. Switching songs plays its finale.
bard.fantasy: Thousandvale's Bard, from Healer OR Rogue. Songs as stances with party buffs, Discord Note, Mending Verse, Grand Finale. From Healer on mana, from Rogue on energy.

trees.name: Valour
trees.blurb: The song that speeds and strengthens.

trees.name: Ruin
trees.blurb: The song that curses, and the discord notes.

trees.name: Mending
trees.blurb: The song that heals, verses, the finale.

wyrmblood.name: Wyrmblood
wyrmblood.blurb: Pick a temper (fire, frost or storm) and every breath, rend and leap follows it. Scales that throw back what hits you.
wyrmblood.fantasy: Thousandvale's Dragon Knight, renamed. Wyrm Temper as a stance that sets the element, Wyrm's Breath (a cone), Scale Rend, Wyrmfall (a leap), Dragonscale, Wyrm Ascendant.

trees.name: Fire Temper
trees.blurb: Burning breath and rends.

trees.name: Frost Temper
trees.blurb: Slowing breath and holds.

trees.name: Scales
trees.blurb: Dragonscale, the leap, the ascendant capstone.

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.blurb: Gadgets. Bolts that go off twice, grenades that change element, a sentry turret, a grappling line and a pocket watch that patches you up.
tinker.fantasy: Thousandvale's Tinker. Clockwork Bolt, Flask Grenade, Deploy Sentry (a stationary ranged minion), Pocket Watch, Grapple Line, Spring Battery (a party haste).

trees.name: Clockwork
trees.blurb: Bolts and grenades.

trees.name: Sentries
trees.blurb: Turrets and what feeds them.

trees.name: Contraptions
trees.blurb: The grapple, the watch, the battery.

chronomancer.name: Chronomancer
chronomancer.blurb: Bends the clock: hastens you and your cooldowns, slows the pack to a crawl, puts you back where you were, and holds a foe still until all its damage lands at once.
chronomancer.fantasy: Thousandvale's Chronomancer. Quicken, Second Hand, Entropy Field (a slow zone), Rewind, Stasis Lock, Stop the Clock. Wants cooldown refunds and a rewind rule.

trees.name: Quicken
trees.blurb: Haste for you and the party.

trees.name: Entropy
trees.blurb: Slows, fields and decay.

trees.name: Stasis
trees.blurb: Holds, rewinds, the stopped clock.

spirit_speaker.name: Spirit Speaker
spirit_speaker.blurb: Plants spirit posts: one heals everyone near it, one strikes, and the Great Post does both. Bolts that jump between foes and heal on the way.
spirit_speaker.fantasy: Thousandvale's Shaman, renamed (the bestiary already uses "shaman" for a monster role). Posts are stationary minions; Spirit Bolt, Warding Spirits, Call Back the Spirit (a full-health revive). From Healer OR Mage, both mana.

trees.name: Posts
trees.blurb: The standing spirits.

trees.name: Spirit Bolts
trees.blurb: Bolts that jump and mend.

trees.name: The Calling
trees.blurb: Wards, the revive, the Great Post.

hexbreaker.name: Hexbreaker
hexbreaker.blurb: Silver strips magic. Pins that root, nets that silence, a circle no spell crosses, and a writ that sends the whole party after one target.
hexbreaker.fantasy: Thousandvale's Witch Hunter, renamed. Silvered Pin, Silver Edge, Null Circle (silence in a zone), Writ of Guilt (a mark), Iron Net, Rite of Purging. Hits casters and the Restless hard. From Rogue on energy, from Healer on mana.

trees.name: Silver
trees.blurb: Pins, edges and the extra damage to the unholy.

trees.name: The Null
trees.blurb: Silences, nets, the circle.

trees.name: The Writ
trees.blurb: Marks, cleansing rites, the purge.

monk.name: Monk
monk.blurb: Every palm strike, step and stance builds poise, and the staff spends it in a widening spin. Light on the feet, hard on the shin.
monk.fantasy: Thousandvale's Monk, from Fighter OR Rogue. Open Palm, Wind Step (the next hit a sure critical), Sweeping Heel, Inner Stillness, Mountain Fist, Ninefold Staff. From Rogue on energy, from Fighter on temper.

trees.name: Open Palm
trees.blurb: Fast strikes and the sure critical.

trees.name: Stillness
trees.blurb: Guard, poise, the still centre.

trees.name: Ninefold
trees.blurb: Sweeps, the line punch, the spin.

runesmith.name: Runesmith
runesmith.blurb: Hammers runes into enemies and into anything that hits you, rends their plate, lights your weapon with forge flame. The great anvil falls with every rune you laid.
runesmith.fantasy: Thousandvale's Runesmith. Rune Hammer, Rend Plate, Runeskin, Forge Flame (a weapon coat), Warding Glyph (an ally ward), The Great Anvil. Wants a rune count on the target.

trees.name: The Hammer
trees.blurb: Runes struck in, plate rent.

trees.name: Runeskin
trees.blurb: Runes on you, glyphs on friends.

trees.name: Forge
trees.blurb: Forge flame and the anvil.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.blurb: Every strike is a gamble: random elements, traps, pitch bombs, and a Big Score that can hit for a fifth or five times, and pays gold on a kill.
scavenger.fantasy: Thousandvale's Scavenger. Lucky Strike, Junk Toss, Scrounge, Caltrop Scatter, Rag-and-Pitch Bomb, Big Score. Wants random element and random multiplier effects.

trees.name: Lucky
trees.blurb: Gambles on every hit.

trees.name: Junk
trees.blurb: Traps, bombs and thrown rubbish.

trees.name: Big Score
trees.blurb: The jackpot and the gold.

starcaller.name: Starcaller
starcaller.blurb: Throws golden stars, calls bigger ones down from the sky, lays fields of them. Stars that land fill the constellation; the big ones spend it.
starcaller.fantasy: Thousandvale's Starcaller. Star Dart, Scattered Stars, Called Star, Star Field, Wheeling Stars, Heavens' Barrage. Wants a 5-point Starlight counter (gained per enemy hit, spent by the big casts).

trees.name: Darts
trees.blurb: Thrown stars that fill the constellation.

trees.name: Called
trees.blurb: Stars from the sky.

trees.name: Fields
trees.blurb: Star fields and the barrage.

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.blurb: Wild magic. Each bolt a random element, a burst that hits harder the more kinds of harm the target carries, a foe turned into something harmless.
sorcerer.fantasy: Thousandvale's Sorcerer. Wild Bolt, Arcane Burst, Mana Rend, Overchannel (health for power), Transmute, Sixfold Ruin. Wants random element, a per-debuff-kind multiplier and a transmute.

trees.name: Wild
trees.blurb: Random elements.

trees.name: Overchannel
trees.blurb: Health for power, mana rends.

trees.name: Ruin
trees.blurb: Transmute and the sixfold strike.

enchanter.name: Enchanter
enchanter.blurb: Puts whole packs to sleep so you pick the fight. A jolt that hits sleepers far harder, a foe turned on its friends, a decoy that lulls what attacks it.
enchanter.fantasy: Thousandvale's Enchanter. Drowse (a sleep: a stun that breaks on damage), Arcane Jolt, Beguile (charm), Lethargy, Phantasm (a decoy minion), Grand Enthrallment. Wants a sleep that breaks on damage and a charm.

trees.name: Drowse
trees.blurb: Sleep and the jolt.

trees.name: Beguile
trees.blurb: Charms and lethargy.

trees.name: Phantasm
trees.blurb: Decoys and the great enthrallment.

shade_dancer.name: Shade Dancer
shade_dancer.blurb: Every cut and step leaves an afterimage that strikes again a moment later. Step behind them, shroud your friends, finish the wounded, and a host of shades copies everything you do.
shade_dancer.fantasy: Thousandvale's Shadow Dancer, renamed. Shade Cut, Umbral Step, Shroud, Cutting Waltz, Assassinate, Host of Shades (short-lived minions). Wants an afterimage effect (a delayed repeat of the hit).

trees.name: Afterimage
trees.blurb: Cuts that strike twice.

trees.name: Umbral Step
trees.blurb: Steps, shrouds and the finish.

trees.name: The Host
trees.blurb: Shades that copy you.
